paginas.texto: Every Friday Valentina tells a story, and every Friday it starts the same way: 'Once upon a time...'
This Friday she started, and then she stopped. She had forgotten the middle.
'First a girl found a door,' she said. 'And then... and then...'
'And then a dragon,' said Mateo. 'There is always a dragon.'
'And then a castle,' said Sofia, who thinks every story needs a map and a castle.
'And then a machine,' said Erik. Everybody looked at Erik.
Valentina wrote it all on the board: the door, the dragon, the castle and, yes, the machine.
'Now,' she said, 'what happens at the END?' Nobody knew. That is always the difficult part.
So they finished it together, and the story was longer and much stranger than the one she forgot.
